newsitem.title: USA: Sharon Energy delays drilling for analysis.
newsitem.headline: Sharon Energy delays drilling for analysis.

text.p: Sharon Energy Ltd said Monday additional drilling in its Merlin 3-D program has been postponed while the results of the first two wells are analyzed.
The company said the Knight Ranch 1-A well was production tested for a calculated absolute open flow potential of 5,956,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day.

It said the second well, the Henning-Lohse 1 well, was not successful and has been plugged. Drilling encountered two pay zones in the Forbes, however log analysis revealed that the gas saturations present were sub-commercial.
